clues: This old city sits in a vale ringed by high, rocky hills. It lies in the north of a land in the heart of South Asia.
The heat here once rose to 48, a fierce mark for any town on Earth. Its summers rank with the most hot of all towns in its land and the world.
Long ago, in the years of the 1500s, a great realm to the north seized this town and its fort. That fall set its path for the next age.
This town holds the most old known stone text that writes the number 0 as a true count mark. No older such stone text is known to us.
This town is one of a small world set of towns named for their gift of song. Its old tunes and deep music roots mark it out for all.
